dialogues.speaker: AURA
dialogues.text: Neural link online. Motor cortex is rusty. Walk it off, operative. Use W, A, S and D.

dialogues.speaker: AURA
dialogues.text: Good. Now open it up. Hold Shift and sprint.

dialogues.speaker: AURA
dialogues.text: Leg actuators responding. Press Space to jump.

dialogues.speaker: AURA
dialogues.text: Build speed, then press C. A slide keeps your momentum and your head down.

dialogues.speaker: AURA
dialogues.text: Katana synced. Left click to strike. Chain three for the full combo.

dialogues.speaker: AURA
dialogues.text: Hold right mouse to guard. Time it as they strike and you will parry.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor Vance
dialogues.text: Good. You remember how to move. Now get down Kuroshio, kid.
